column1: # ARM tag/bool contracts, metadata checks and setup/gate forms.
# META keys, KEYS/SEEN memory and word output remain caller-bound.
# Setreg accepts exactly one explicit imm/reg/mem/addr tag in the value position.
# Boolean operands have their own kind; other tokens fall back to register parsing.
# Metadata keys must be known and unique on the current input line.
# Dispatch semantic keys using the current META enumeration; other declared keys pass through.
# Relocation annotations must agree with jump/jumpz/call.
# Gate form, gate kind and carry metadata are validated independently.
# Tagged setreg dispatch and setup output; word bytes come from the caller sequence.
